skipped.message: D-FUEL-TABLE: hard-coded fuel table disagrees with fleet_data.csv (capacity, t/day at design speed, speed) -- two sources of truth
D-SVC-CAP: candidate services carry capacities (10,000-14,000 TEU in the seeded pool) that no vessel in the WorldSmall fleet (max 7,500) can provide
D-SVC-CAP: Service.capacity is a size bucket, not the capacity of the fleet class named in Service.vessel_class
D-SVC-CYCLE: cycle_time is a hard-coded 7/14/21 days, not derived from route distance and speed; most rotations cannot be sailed in that time
D-CAP-FREQ: HubMILP/FrequencyGA multiply weekly capacity by 7/cycle_time while the fleet check treats frequency as sailings/week
D-ACCT-PROFIT: HubMILP 'profit' is the augmented solver objective (unserved penalty + coverage reward), not revenue - total_cost
D-ACCT-TRANSSHIP: reported transship_cost uses the flat default (80/TEU) while the objective prices port-specific rates
D-MILP-FLEET: a chromosome that needs more vessels than the fleet crashes the MILP (PuLP: 'A False object cannot be passed as a constraint') instead of returning an explicit infeasible status
